packages.label: רוּחַ חַיִּים
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of ruach (breath/spirit) as the life-force that animates every thing. Includes: the sigh (אנחה) as the drawing of that spirit; ארך אפים (long-breathing) as the nature of the sigh; שלמות החסרון / מלאפום as what the ruach fills; the body organs (חטם, פניו) through which ruach passes; צפון-wind and David's harp as expressions of the same holy spirit; the letter vav and the encompassing (מקיף) as further faces of ruach-drawing. The tzaddik's 13 attributes of mercy are also the holy ruach. Dominant node is רוח חיים with the highest degree (6 bechina edges).
merge_notes: Merged raw component (שלמות החסרון, מלאפום, נתמלא החסרון, הרחב פיך ואמלאהו, ויתן לך משאלת לבך): these 5 nodes share the nature of 'filling of the void', which is what the ruach-chaim accomplishes — same essential nature, not a downstream effect.
Merged raw component (טלית, רוח מארבע רוחות): the holy tallit draws spirit from four winds — same nature as ruach-chaim drawing.
Merged raw component (חטם, רוח, פניו): body organs that are bechina of ruach — same essential nature as life-breath.
Merged raw component (רוח צפונית, רוח החיים): direct bechina of holy ruach-chaim.
Merged raw component (אות וא״ו, המשכת הרוח): vav is the drawing of the spirit — same essential drawing-of-breath nature.
Merged raw component (חיות של אותו הדבר, רוח חיים של אותו הדבר): the vitality of any thing IS its ruach-chaim — identical nature stated explicitly.

packages.label: תְּפִלָּה וּבְרִיאָה בְּכֹחַ
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of 'creation in potential' (בריאה בכח) — the latent, hidden dimension above nature. Prayer is bechina of חדוש העולם (renewal of the world), of עדן (the hidden Garden), of עדן עין לא ראתה (the future hidden light), and of בריאה בכח. חכמה (wisdom) is a spring (מעין) — the potential wellspring activated by prayer. The התעוררות החכמה that comes through prayer is also בריאה בכח. These nodes all inhabit the domain of the hidden/potential before it is actualized into Torah-study.
merge_notes: Merged raw component (חכמה, מעין): חכמה is the spring/מעין that flows from prayer. Its essential nature — the latent wellspring of wisdom — is the same dimension as 'potential creation' (בריאה בכח). Connected to תפלה via its bechina relationship to התעוררות החכמה שהוא בתפלה.
Note: עדן עין לא ראתה initially formed its own 2-node component with אור הגנוז לעתיד, but was then connected to תפלה via edge 39, making it part of this component in the primary pass.

packages.label: תּוֹרָה וּבְרִיאָה בְּפֹעַל
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of 'creation in act' (בריאה בפועל) — Torah is the craftsman/אמן through which the world was actually created. The כנור of David (5 strings = 5 Books of Moses) is bechina of Torah. The spirit of Torah (רוח מ״ם = 40 days of Sinai, also ורוח אלקים מרחפת על פני המים) and the lance/רומח are all expressions of Torah as actualized creative force. The souls of Israel who study Torah are the garden-plants that grow in the Torah-garden.
merge_notes: Merged raw component (רוח מ״ם, ורוח אלקים מרחפת, רומח): the spirit/ruach of Torah given at 40 days, which is also the divine spirit hovering over the waters (Torah). The lance (רומח) is the same bechina — instrument that draws/projects the spirit of Torah.
Merged raw component (נשמות ישראל, עשבין ודשאין): souls studying Torah are garden-plants — their essential nature is as fruits/students of the Torah-garden, which is itself the Torah.

packages.label: עֵשָׂו וְרוּחַ הַטֻּמְאָה
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of the evil counterpart to the holy ruach-chaim: the storm-wind (רוח סערה) of Esav, who draws his vitality from the evil Rav (רב דקלפה). אלופי עשו / אלפי are the commanders of Esav's camp (the klipa-rav's officers). כשתויי יין (the wine-drunk) is bechina of Esav the red/Edomite. The evil tallit (טלית דקלפה = טלית אדום, the red garment = Esav's hairy garment) corresponds to the holy tallit. רוח הטמאה is bechina of רוח סערה, the violent storm-wind that Esav draws — great in its moment but with no permanence. This is the evil mirror of Package 1 (רוח חיים).
merge_notes: Merged raw component (טלית דקלפה, טלית אדום): the evil/red tallit is Esav's 'hairy garment' — it is explicitly the evil counterpart of the holy four-winged tallit. אדום = Edom = Esav. Same essential nature as the Esav cluster.

Merged raw component (רוח הטמאה, רוח סערה): the impure wind is bechina of the storm-wind, and the Torah text explicitly links this to 'הן עשו אחי איש שעיר' — Esav the hairy one. Same essential nature as the Esav cluster.
